metadata.title: Packaged Commodity Compliance Rules
metadata.purpose: AI-assisted compliance screening of pre-packaged commodities
metadata.warning: This rule database is for compliance screening and not legal certification.
metadata.source: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India

product_name.name: Common / Generic Name
product_name.description: The package should declare the common or generic name of the commodity.
product_name.failure_message: Common or generic name of the commodity was not detected.

manufacturer_packer_importer.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
manufacturer_packer_importer.description: The applicable name and address information for manufacturer, packer or importer must be declared.
manufacturer_packer_importer.failure_message: Applicable manufacturer, packer or importer information was not detected.

manufacturer_address.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Address
manufacturer_address.description: The applicable address information should be declared.
manufacturer_address.failure_message: Required address information was not detected.

country_of_origin.name: Country of Origin
country_of_origin.description: Country of origin should be declared for imported products.
country_of_origin.failure_message: Country of origin was not detected for an imported product.

net_quantity.name: Net Quantity
net_quantity.description: Net quantity should be declared in terms of standard units of weight, measure or number, as applicable.

quantity_unit.name: Standard Unit
quantity_unit.description: The quantity should use an appropriate standard unit of weight, measure or number.
quantity_unit.failure_message: Quantity unit is missing or could not be validated.

manufacture_date.name: Month and Year of Manufacture
manufacture_date.description: Month and year of manufacture should be declared where applicable.
manufacture_date.failure_message: Month and year of manufacture were not detected.

packing_date.name: Packing / Pre-packing Information
packing_date.description: Packing or pre-packing information may be relevant depending on the product and applicable requirement.
packing_date.failure_message: Packing information could not be detected where applicable.

best_before_use_by.name: Best Before / Use By
best_before_use_by.description: Best before or use by information should be declared for commodities to which the requirement applies.
best_before_use_by.failure_message: Best-before or use-by information was not detected where applicable.

mrp.name: Maximum Retail Price
mrp.description: Retail sale price should be declared in Indian currency and in the prescribed form.
mrp.failure_message: Maximum Retail Price was not detected.

mrp_inclusive_of_taxes.name: MRP Tax Inclusion
mrp_inclusive_of_taxes.description: MRP declaration should follow the prescribed tax-inclusive requirement.
mrp_inclusive_of_taxes.failure_message: Required MRP tax-inclusive wording was not detected.

consumer_care.name: Consumer Care Details
consumer_care.description: Consumer care / complaint contact information should be declared.
consumer_care.failure_message: Consumer care details were not detected.

dimensions.name: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Dimensions should be declared where the size of the commodity is relevant.

unit_sale_price.name: Unit Sale Price
unit_sale_price.description: Unit sale price should be declared in the prescribed form according to the quantity or measure of the commodity.
unit_sale_price.failure_message: Unit sale price was not detected.

number_of_items.name: Number / Unit / Piece / Pair / Set
number_of_items.description: For items sold by number, the number, unit, piece, pair, set or other appropriate quantity expression should be declared.
number_of_items.failure_message: Required number or unit declaration was not detected.

promotional_group.name: Promotional Retail Group
promotional_group.description: Where packages intended for retail sale are grouped for a promotional retail offer, every package in the group should comply with Rule 6.
promotional_group.failure_message: One or more packages in the promotional group may not contain required Rule 6 declarations.

declaration_legibility.name: Declaration Legibility
declaration_legibility.description: Required declarations should be clear, legible and conspicuous.
declaration_legibility.failure_message: One or more declarations may not be sufficiently legible.

declaration_language.name: Declaration Language
declaration_language.description: Required declarations should be made in Hindi in Devanagari script or English, with additional languages permitted.
declaration_language.failure_message: Required declaration language could not be verified.

wholesale_package.name: Wholesale Package Declarations
wholesale_package.description: Wholesale packages are subject to the declarations specified for wholesale packages.
wholesale_package.failure_message: Required wholesale package declarations were not detected.

registration.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Registration
registration.description: Registration status cannot reliably be verified from a package photograph alone.

quantity_accuracy.name: Quantity Accuracy / Maximum Permissible Error
quantity_accuracy.description: A camera image alone cannot establish actual net quantity or maximum permissible error. Physical weighing or measurement is required.
quantity_accuracy.failure_message: Physical measurement is required to verify quantity accuracy.

overall_status_rules.COMPLIANT: All applicable critical and high-severity checks pass.
overall_status_rules.NON_COMPLIANT: One or more applicable critical requirements fail.
overall_status_rules.REVIEW: Required information cannot be reliably verified automatically.
